question: Does immutable Ashwarden hand-size-payoff evidence remain source-identical and provide current whole-run policy sensitivity, reachability and separation from Poison; if not, do the frozen acquisition states give a first-acquisition state lock measured decision value?
retrospectiveScope: This is a declared retrospective, zero-new-row reconciliation and necessary-capacity audit. Immutable #524/#525 complementarity is not re-estimated. Whole-run activation uses only registered producer play, Phantom Blades play/direct damage and final-deck acquisition witnesses. The state-lock capacity screen does not infer acquisition order or an unexecuted intervention outcome; a pass can authorise only the exact binary knob and identity preflight.

sourceReconciliation.claim: The #525 source commit and current main are byte-identical for content, combat rules, pilot and whole-run simulator before research-only instrumentation.

ash-hand-size-payoff.activation: At least one final deck contains Phantom Blades and Preparation or Surge; Phantom Blades and a present producer are both played; phantomDamage is positive.

stateLock.name: firstAcquisitionPackageLock
stateLock.null: Level 0 must reproduce the frozen path, fields, policy, RNG and results exactly.
stateLock.enabled: At each policy card-acquisition decision, inspect only the current deck. If it contains at least one registered non-starter lock token from exactly one within-aspect package, cards registered only to the other package are ineligible in reward, card-pick event and policy shop acquisition. If neither or both token sets are present, no card is filtered. No persistent state or fitted threshold exists.
stateLock.intendedMediator: Card-acquisition eligibility after the first unambiguous package-specific card enters the deck.
stateLock.aliasStructure: Level 1 is invalid with universal packageOrder, positive-median policyPackageOrder or normalised-payoff policyPackageCommitment enabled; those grammars are closed.
stateLock.identityBeforeRows: Exact null, uncommitted, left-committed, right-committed, ambiguous-both, unrelated-card, reward, event and policy-shop surfaces must pass before any whole-run row.

estimands.sourceIdentity: Exact Git-blob hashes at #525 source and current main, plus exact live/candidate hand-size card packets.
estimands.packageSupport: Per arm and package, root-550 active/inactive, final-pair reachable and consumer-reached policy counts.
estimands.functionalSeparation: Within each aspect and arm, active-policy left-only, right-only and cross-active counts.
estimands.stateLockCapacity: Within each aspect and arm, policy counts acquiring only the left lock-token set, only the right set or both; do not infer which token arrived first.
estimands.faults: Count policy rows with a non-empty error or stall/error outcome.

gates.provenance: The 32/32 sensitivity, 16 reachability and eight separation minima are inherited unchanged from the package-order held-out protocol. Sixteen cross-active/dual-token policies is the unchanged reachability minimum applied to a decision-changing interference mediator.

decisionRules.admission: On structuralNull, every package has at least 32 active and 32 inactive policies, at least 16 final-pair and consumer-reached policies, both aspect pairs have at least eight package-only policies in each direction, and faults are zero.
decisionRules.stateLock: If admission fails, both packages in both aspects still have at least 32 active and 16 reachable/consumer-reached policies; each aspect has at least 16 cross-active and dual-token policies, at least eight left-token-only and eight right-token-only policies, and zero faults.
decisionRules.futility: Neither the full current inventory nor the state-lock necessary-capacity gate passes on structuralNull.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable Git/file/content/ledger hash, complete rectangle, exact policy identity, numeric input or wall-time assertion fails before the deterministic decision.
decisionRules.admissionAuthority: Admit the current four-package inventory for matched detector construction without promoting the closed scalar or order grammars. This does not authorise detector calibration, product promotion or protected seeds by itself.
decisionRules.stateLockAuthority: Authorise implementation of exactly the binary firstAcquisitionPackageLock research knob and its preregistered identity surfaces. Do not authorise a simulator row until identity passes; do not infer acquisition order, tune a threshold, add ML/RL, admit a detector, promote product content or spend protected seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the first-acquisition state-lock direction before implementation and continue to a materially different evidence-backed structure inside issue #421.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record no decision and run no simulator row until the immutable evidence fault is resolved.
